'''Brian Hunter''' (GPN / DeckTech handle '''HuntaWarya''')<ref name="dt-23598">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23598 Saber Combat done RIGHT aka No Mans Land], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 26 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23598/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23598/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009132707/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23598/ Wayback Machine].</ref> won the [[2002 Vegas DPC]] 5–0 with a [[Light]] [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Plead My Case To The Senate]] list (''LS Senate done RIGHT aka Ghhhks Away'').<ref name="dt-23407">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23407 LS Senate done RIGHT aka Ghhhks Away], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 18 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23407/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23407/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009165649/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23407/ Wayback Machine].</ref><ref name="dpc-vegas-tr">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-15-vegas-baby-lush-at-the-vegas-dpcd3660/ vegas-baby-lush-at-the-vegas-dpc], Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, DeckTech (15 May 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-15-vegas-baby-lush-at-the-vegas-dpcd3660/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He won the [[2002 Houston DPC]].<ref name="dpc-houston-tr">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-07-16-houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houstond3841/ houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houston], Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, DeckTech (16 July 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-07-16-houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houstond3841/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He finished 2nd at the [[2006 World Championship]] in Chicago, losing to [[Nate Meeker]].<ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20230817222457/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ 17 August 2023]</ref>

== 2007 World Championship interview ==
At the [[2007 World Championship]], his sixth Worlds, Hunter said he first attended Worlds in 2001 and did not travel to major events until 2000, and that he considered 1997–1999 his peak. He qualified for 2007 by winning West Nationals.<ref name="hunter07">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=swSmLNAG62A&t=783s Worlds 2007 P Johnson Interview], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (uploaded 7 April 2026), at 13:03. Transcript: [[2007 World Championship interviews (transcript)]].</ref> Before Wizards of the Coast released its ''Star Wars'' trading card game, the company flew six Decipher SWCCG players to Seattle to see it. Hunter won the first Wizards tournament he entered and played in that game's first world championship, but preferred to keep playing SWCCG.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=swSmLNAG62A&t=1180s Worlds 2007 P Johnson Interview], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (uploaded 7 April 2026), at 19:40. Transcript: [[2007 World Championship interviews (transcript)]].</ref>
